title: allocation-fault soak (query-thread): exception safety of the CAS post-durable window

verdicts.name: allocation-fault injection is armable through the driver's URL parameters
verdicts.expected: a probe query throws MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED ... fault injected

verdicts.name: no query hung past its bound
workload still made progress under faults (acked volume for the loss oracle)
cluster comes back after the restart
verdicts.expected: both replicas healthy within the timeout

verdicts.name: the post-restart view (rebuilt from the durable journal) equals the pre-restart view
verdicts.expected: identical checksum, active part names and per-block row counts on every replica

verdicts.name: every ACKED insert's rows are present after the restart
S42 replica agreement
fsck pre-restart: stale_edge == 0 (detail mode)
verdicts.note: blobs whose every source edge names a manifest that no longer exists: their in-degree can never reach zero, so the incremental GC will never reclaim them

verdicts.name: fsck pre-restart: dangling == 0 and unaccounted == 0
fsck post-restart: stale_edge == 0 (detail mode)
verdicts.note: blobs whose every source edge names a manifest that no longer exists: their in-degree can never reach zero, so the incremental GC will never reclaim them

verdicts.name: fsck post-restart: dangling == 0 and unaccounted == 0
snapshot integrity oracle (replay of covered logs == published snapshot)
CasRefApplyPoisoned == 0 (no durable transaction lost from a writer cache)
no snapshot advanced across a poisoned transaction
verdicts.note: no transaction was poisoned this run, so nothing could advance across one. The snapshot integrity oracle above is the unconditional half of this check and DID run. Reported rather than skipped: `skipped` outranks `pass` in the harness, so a structurally-vacuous branch would otherwise cap every healthy run.

verdicts.name: allocation faults were actually injected (generic anti-vacuity)
verdicts.expected: > 0 injected allocation failures during the armed window
verdicts.note: generic only — proves SOME allocation failed, NOT that the post-durable window was hit. This guard STAYS gating (2026-07-25 decision): a run in which no allocation fault occurred at all must never read green.

verdicts.name: post-durable install window traversal (reported, not gating)
verdicts.expected: > 0 targeted signals (CasRefApplyPoisoned transitions or post-PUT failpoint hits)
verdicts.note: the window was NOT proven traversed: a nonzero MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED count proves only that SOME allocation failed, never that the few-instruction post-durable install region was entered while armed. no server-reachable post-durable-install failpoint exists: the §A1 seam is the gtest-only `CasRefLedger::setInstallRegionProbeForTest` hook and no CAS failpoint is registered in src/Common/FailPoint.cpp. With §A1 landed the region allocates nothing, so this counter is EXPECTED to stay 0. Per the 2026-07-25 decision this no longer gates: green means the consistency oracle held, not that the target window was hit.

verdicts.name: zero LOGICAL_ERROR (queries may fail; invariants may not)
statements failed only with the injected allocation error
verdicts.expected: 0 statement failures of any other kind during the armed window

verdicts.name: no permanently wedged ref lane (an unarmed write lands after the run)
verdicts.expected: an INSERT succeeds within 120s of the restart

verdicts.name: GC rounds succeed again after disarm
CasGcUnmatchedRemoveDeltas (reported, not gating)
verdicts.note: removal deltas that matched no existing source edge; a per-key no-op by design, but a persistent rate means deltas reach the reducer without their activation

verdicts.name: ref-lane wedge counters (reported)
S3 error rates (info)
verdicts.note: 10-20% read-error rates were invisible all campaign (2026-07-06 re-audit); a spike here explains retry storms/slowness in the same window

verdicts.name: fsck dangling
dryrun ⊆ deletable (unreachable ∪ pending-gc)
event audit (no bad rows)
GC no Failed rounds
no unbounded leftovers
verdicts.expected: residual is condemned pipeline (pending-gc) and/or bookkeeping
verdicts.note: no uncondemned orphan content; 0 object(s) are condemned and awaiting ack-floor graduation (two-phase delete pipeline — drains once the retired-view sync advances the floor)

soundness_guard.post_put_failpoint_why: no server-reachable post-durable-install failpoint exists: the §A1 seam is the gtest-only `CasRefLedger::setInstallRegionProbeForTest` hook and no CAS failpoint is registered in src/Common/FailPoint.cpp
